collection_name: Telugu Wikisource — proofread texts and scanned-book indexes
description: Free library of transcribed Telugu texts — classical kavyas (Andhra Mahabharatam, Bhagavatam, satakas), modern literature, reference works, and books re-licensed by authors (e.g. CIS-A2K releases) — many linked page-by-page to scans (ProofreadPage).
genres: kavya; prabandha; sataka; novels; essays; reference; devotional; government texts
formats: Wiki text; HTML; EPUB/PDF export (WS Export); XML dumps
size_telugu: 24,970 content pages; 247,400 total pages; 1,651 Index (scanned book) pages; 1,308 Author pages (API, 2026-11-09)
metadata_fields: author; year; source scan; proofreading status per page
ocr_transcription: Pages transcribed/proofread by volunteers on top of OCR (Google/Tesseract/Indic OCR gadgets).
acquisition_method: Dumps: https://dumps.wikimedia.org/tewikisource/latest/tewikisource-latest-pages-articles.xml.bz2 ; HF wikimedia/wikisource config 20231201.te (9,012 rows, 36 MB); page-level text via API prop=revisions in namespace 104 (పుట).
license: CC BY-SA 4.0 for contributions; transcribed works are PD or released under free licences
copyright_notes: Text of PD works is PD; re-licensed modern books carry CC BY-SA.
verification_method: MediaWiki siteinfo API; namespace page counts (Index 106, Author 102) via allpages
unresolved_issues: Count of Page-namespace (పుట) pages and proofread share not obtained (API rate limit).
processing_needs: Separate validated pages from unproofread OCR; strip templates.

collection_name: Telugu Palm Leaf Manuscripts Collection (GOML Chennai scans)
organization: Government Oriental Manuscripts Library & Research Centre (GOML), Chennai — scans via Tamil Virtual Academy; mirrored on IA
description: Page images (with machine OCR attempts) of Telugu palm-leaf and paper manuscripts held at GOML Chennai — puranas, kavyas, Bhagavatam, yakshaganas, sastra texts (e.g. Balarama Caritramu, Brhannaradiyamu). Item metadata cites tamildigitallibrary.in/goml-data?language=telugu as source.
ocr_transcription: IA ran Tesseract 5.3 but palm-leaf script variants make OCR unreliable — treat as images only.
acquisition_method: ia download --search 'collection:telugu-palm-leaf' --glob='*.pdf'
copyright_notes: Manuscript texts are PD; the source portal (Tamil Virtual Academy) states 'all rights reserved' for its site — the PD Mark was applied by the IA uploader.
provenance: GOML holds 50,580 palm-leaf and 22,134 paper manuscripts in many languages (item description).
verification_method: IA API (count, licence on all items, size); item metadata read (source, description)
unresolved_issues: Tension between PD Mark on IA and TVA site's rights line; no transcriptions.
processing_needs: Needs palm-leaf HTR model + expert transcription; layout segmentation (see Indiscapes TEL-OCR-013).
